scope: one route, one session chain, one pagination cursor

negativeControl.mutation: replace the page-local exception profile with the ordinary profile on the same page
negativeControl.expected: http success with a hint or string array and businessOracle=false

stopsWhen: the same typed business payload is observed with the ordinary profile on the exceptional page
the difference follows a session, signer, transport, or permission mutation instead of the page-local request profile
the exception profile still lacks the typed business oracle
sibling pages also require the exception profile
